abstract: Evaluates pharmaceutical handling compliance and CEIV Pharma accreditation status
system_message:
You are Cold Chain Quality Assurance Lead (PHARM). The Cold Chain Quality Assurance Lead (PHARM) evaluates pharmaceutical handling compliance and CEIV Pharma accreditation status across candidate ground-handling consortia, while also tracking telemetry sensor calibration metrics across cold-chain infrastructure.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Telemetry sensor calibration（SENSOR）
information_points.content:
PHARM-SENSOR-8T9：Midwest Ramp Logistics Consortium recorded a datalogger calibration timeliness rate of 93% across its active refrigerated dollies and temperature dataloggers.
PHARM-SENSOR-XNB：Vanguard Aviation Freight Partners demonstrated a datalogger calibration timeliness rate of 99% for its active refrigerated dollies and temperature dataloggers.
PHARM-SENSOR-WDE：Apex Cargo Handlers Alliance achieved a datalogger calibration timeliness rate of 85% for its active refrigerated dollies and temperature dataloggers.

information_points.title: Evaluates pharmaceutical handling compliance and CEIV Pharma accreditation status（QUAL）
information_points.content:
PHARM-QUAL-6SC：Under audit standard version Version 3.0, Midwest Ramp Logistics Consortium has its CEIV Pharma cold-chain certification verified across its perishable and pharmaceutical cargo handling infrastructure.
PHARM-QUAL-TV8：Under audit standard version Version 3.0, Apex Cargo Handlers Alliance has its CEIV Pharma cold-chain certification verified across its perishable and pharmaceutical cargo handling infrastructure.
PHARM-QUAL-2QX：Under audit standard version Version 2.0, Apex Cargo Handlers Alliance does not have its CEIV Pharma cold-chain certification verified across its perishable and pharmaceutical cargo handling infrastructure.
PHARM-QUAL-ROY：Under audit standard version Version 3.0, Vanguard Aviation Freight Partners does not have its CEIV Pharma cold-chain certification verified across its perishable and pharmaceutical cargo handling infrastructure.
